annotations.title: Check if a tx was a USDC payment to TensorFeed

description: On-chain lookup: was this transaction hash a USDC payment to TensorFeed's canonical payment wallet (0x549c82e6bFC54bdaE9A2073744CBC2AF5D1FC6D1) on Base mainnet? Returns structured details if yes. For credit attribution and endpoint mapping, the paying agent should call https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/history with its bearer token.
